mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number, o.order_type, o.total_price, o.order_status, o.created_at, ( SELECT p.payment_method FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.payment_status = '성공' ORDER BY p.payment_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS paymentMethod FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status != '결제대기' ORDER BY o.order_id DESC
SELECT order_id, order_number, order_type, total_price, order_status, created_at FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = '취소' WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status NOT IN ('완료', '취소')
mapper.select:
SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, m.menu_name AS menuName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS unitPrice, o.option_id AS optionId, o.option_name AS optionName, o.option_price AS optionPrice FROM order_items oi
INNER JOIN menus m ON m.menu_id = oi.menu_id
LEFT JOIN order_item_options oio ON oio.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
LEFT JOIN options o ON o.option_id = oio.option_id
WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC, o.option_id ASC

SELECT snapshot.order_item_id AS orderItemId, snapshot.component_menu_id AS componentMenuId, snapshot.component_menu_name AS componentMenuName FROM order_item_set_components snapshot
INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = snapshot.order_item_id
WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY snapshot.order_item_id ASC, snapshot.component_menu_id ASC
SELECT payment_method FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND payment_status = '성공' ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId, amount, payment_method AS paymentMethod, payment_status AS paymentStatus, fail_reason AS failReason, payment_key AS paymentKey, attempted_at AS attemptedAt FROM payments WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND payment_status = '성공' ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET payment_status = '취소' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND payment_status = '성공'
